Josh was born on 4 September 1992 in [Bermondsey, London](/wiki/Bermondsey,_London "Bermondsey, London"). He attended [Bexley Grammar School](/wiki/Bexley_Grammar_School "Bexley Grammar School") in [Welling](/wiki/Welling "Welling"), where he met future fellow Sidemen member [Tobi Brown](/wiki/TBJZL "TBJZL"). He claims to have had an interest in architecture in his early years, and used to love designing houses.[[5]](#cite_note-SidemenBook-5) As a child, Josh took dance lessons and competed in [street dance](/wiki/Street_dance "Street dance") performances.[[8]](#cite_note-8) His parents went through a divorce growing up, which he states led to him playing games. He claims to have played *Call of Duty* in his room for 8 hours, because he wanted an escape from the stress of his parents' divorce.[[9]](#cite_note-:2-9)[[10]](#cite_note-10) In the Netflix documentary, *The Sidemen Story*, Josh had mentioned that he suffered from [anxiety](/wiki/Anxiety "Anxiety").[[11]](#cite_note-11)

He later attended [Ravensbourne University](/wiki/Ravensbourne_University_London "Ravensbourne University London") and earned an upper second honours degree in digital film production.[[5]](#cite_note-SidemenBook-5) Before getting into content creation, Josh tried working in a bank in London with his father, who was a banker himself, but left soon after. He also had a week-long stint at the [Sky Sports](/wiki/Sky_Sports "Sky Sports") studio.[[5]](#cite_note-SidemenBook-5)

In 2009, Josh created his first YouTube channel, *Zerkaa*,[[12]](#cite_note-12) to which he primarily uploaded video game content from games like *[Call of Duty](/wiki/Call_of_Duty "Call of Duty")* and *[FIFA](/wiki/FIFA_(video_game_series) "FIFA (video game series)")*.[[13]](#cite_note-FIFAGambling-13) He has subsequently launched six more solo YouTube channels — namely *ZerkaaPlays, ZerkaaReacts, ZerkaaLive, ZerkaaActuallyPlays, ZerkaaGuesses, and ZerkaaCards.*

fanoutqa_005749.x:
Essential amino acid :: Essentiality in humans :: chunk_0002
Of the twenty amino acids common to all life forms (not counting [selenocysteine](/wiki/Selenocysteine "Selenocysteine")), humans cannot synthesize nine: [histidine](/wiki/Histidine "Histidine"), [isoleucine](/wiki/Isoleucine "Isoleucine"), [leucine](/wiki/Leucine "Leucine"), [lysine](/wiki/Lysine "Lysine"), [methionine](/wiki/Methionine "Methionine"), [phenylalanine](/wiki/Phenylalanine "Phenylalanine"), [threonine](/wiki/Threonine "Threonine"), [tryptophan](/wiki/Tryptophan "Tryptophan") and [valine](/wiki/Valine "Valine"). Additionally, the amino acids [arginine](/wiki/Arginine "Arginine"), [cysteine](/wiki/Cysteine "Cysteine"), [glutamine](/wiki/Glutamine "Glutamine"), [glycine](/wiki/Glycine "Glycine"), [proline](/wiki/Proline "Proline") and [tyrosine](/wiki/Tyrosine "Tyrosine") are considered **conditionally essential**,[[8]](#cite_note-8) which means that specific populations who do not synthesize it in adequate amounts, such as newborn infants and people with diseased livers who are unable to synthesize cysteine, must obtain one or more of these conditionally essential amino acids from their diet.[[9]](#cite_note-9)[[10]](#cite_note-10) For example, enough arginine is synthesized by the urea cycle to meet the needs of an adult but perhaps not those of a growing child. Amino acids that must be obtained from the diet are called **essential amino acids**.

[Eukaryotes](/wiki/Eukaryotes "Eukaryotes") can synthesize some of the amino acids from other [substrates](/wiki/Substrate_(biochemistry) "Substrate (biochemistry)"). Consequently, only a subset of the amino acids used in protein synthesis are [essential nutrients](/wiki/Essential_nutrient "Essential nutrient").

Mourning shattered Charlotte's blocked-shots records, becoming the Hornets' all-time career leader in the 49th game of the season. The greatest moment of Mourning's rookie season came on May 5, 1993, in Game 4 of a first-round playoff series against the [Boston Celtics](/wiki/Boston_Celtics "Boston Celtics"). His 20-footer with .4 seconds left gave the Hornets a 104–103 victory in the game and a 3–1 victory in the series. The Hornets lost in the second round to the [New York Knicks](/wiki/New_York_Knicks "New York Knicks") in five games, with Mourning averaging 23.8 points, 9.9 rebounds and 3.4 blocks in nine playoff games.
